verdict.rationale: gstack ships as a CLI-driven skill framework: skills are invoked as CLI commands (ship, qa, review, autoplan, upgrade), it detects global vs vendored install and runs upgrades via a CLI, and a compiled CLI binary ($B) drives its browser daemon. Community discussion also references its 'git-clone-and-copy install model,' confirming a CLI-based installation/workflow used directly by AI agents. Missing for 10: no independent hands-on review of the CLI's command surface/UX, and no first-party CLI reference/spec doc distinct from skill descriptions.
